appfunction.description: Returns OneByOne task planning guidance (how to break tasks into nested children subtasks) and allowed sticky-note colors.
Reads all todo lists, nested subtasks, list IDs, and the current workspace revision token required before updating a list.
Creates a new todo list with optional sticky-note color and nested subtasks (todosJson array where each item has id, title, optional completed, and optional children array).
Updates an existing todo list using listId and revision from listTaskLists, submitting the complete nested todosJson tree.
Reverts the most recent task list modification when OneByOne is active.
